title: How to Beat The Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
description:
The Applicant Tracking System is a common tool used amongst job boards and companies alike to sort through and refine hundreds, or thousands of job applications in the fraction of a time it would take a real person. Yet, this technology is flawed, and if your resume isn't up to the standards, you will likely miss out on your dream job. On this episode of the Teal Podcast, we discuss how to beat the Applicant Tracking System
